description: Rug check for a Robinhood Chain token before you buy (path parameter addr = token contract). Returns the LP ownership profile of each tracked Uniswap v4 pool for the token: the share of liquidity the creator or LP adder can pull (insiderShare), and the shares burned, held by launchpad or locker contracts, or held by other wallets, plus LP age and a class (held, safe, unknown, empty). Pools under 6 hours old are re-profiled on a rolling basis (about every 10 minutes; checkedAt per row). Tokens still on the Pons launchpad bonding curve answer class pons-curve with the curve, creator, fill progress, ETH in the curve, age and fees: a curve has no LP to pull until it graduates. Untracked tokens answer 404 and are not charged. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

addr.description: Robinhood Chain token contract address (0x + 40 hex)

name: rh_token_rugcheck
